title: Vertiv Q2 2026 results furnished on Form 8-K
excerpt: Vertiv reported Q2 2026 net sales of USD 3.274 billion, adjusted operating margin of 22.6%, adjusted diluted EPS of USD 1.52, and adjusted free cash flow of USD 925 million.
summary: Current primary results for the quarter ended 2026-06-30. Sales rose 24%, adjusted operating profit rose 51%, adjusted margin expanded 410 basis points, and adjusted free cash flow rose 234%. Revenue reflected temporary supply-chain congestion and multi-phased project timing. Vertiv ended Q2 with USD 5.6 billion liquidity and net cash, and raised full-year guidance to USD 13.8-14.2 billion sales, USD 6.65-6.75 adjusted EPS, and USD 2.4-2.6 billion adjusted free cash flow.
